description.en: Lightweight JSON-based vector animation format and cross-platform runtime.
description.zh: 基于 JSON 格式的高性能轻量矢量动画标准格式与跨平台运行时。

content.en: Lottie is an open-source animation file format that renders After Effects vector animations in real time using JSON. Maintained and popularized by LottieFiles, it allows designers to ship rich, resolution-independent vector illustrations and icon micro-animations at a fraction of the weight of GIFs or MP4s.
content.zh: Lottie 是一种将 Adobe After Effects 复杂矢量动画解析为纯 JSON 数据并在多端原生渲染的标准技术。相比传统 GIF 或 MP4 视频，Lottie 文件体积减少 80% 以上且无论如何缩放均保持矢量锐利清晰，广泛应用于应用启动引导与交互成就动画。
